Tenant.title: Tenant
Tenant.description: A tenant renting a room, flat, or shop unit under a landlord account.

userId.description: Authenticated landlord UID owning this tenant record.

roomNumber.description: Room, floor, portion, or shop label.

phone.description: Contact mobile number of the tenant.

initialMeterReading.description: Starting sub-meter kWh reading when tenant joined or tracking started.

openingBalance.description: Opening balance in INR before first tracked month (positive = due, negative = advance).

active.description: Whether the tenant is currently active or vacated.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (client submits FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated (client submits FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

MonthlyLedger.title: MonthlyLedger
MonthlyLedger.description: Monthly rent, sub-meter reading, electricity calculation, payment, and carry-forward balance for a tenant.

electricityMode.description: Calculation method used for electricity charge.

ratePerUnit.description: Effective or fixed per-unit electricity rate in INR.

previousBalance.description: Balance carried forward from previous month in INR (positive = due, negative = advance).

amountPaid.description: Total amount paid by the tenant for this month in INR.

paymentNote.description: Optional note about payment date or partial payment.

closingBalance.description: Resulting balance after payment in INR (positive = due, negative = advance).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (client submits FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated (client submits FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

MainMeterLog.title: MainMeterLog
MainMeterLog.description: Monthly government electricity main meter reading and official DISCOM bill record.

consumerNumber.description: Government DISCOM meter or consumer account number.

prevReading.description: Previous main meter reading in kWh.

currReading.description: Current main meter reading in kWh.

unitsConsumed.description: Total units recorded on the government main meter.

govtBillAmount.description: Official government electricity bill amount in INR.

billPaid.description: Whether the government electricity bill has been paid.

notes.description: Notes on billing cycle, subsidy, or common area usage.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (client submits FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated (client submits FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

BillingSettings.title: BillingSettings
BillingSettings.description: Default landlord preferences for electricity calculation mode and per-unit rate.

defaultRatePerUnit.description: Default electricity rate in INR per kWh unit.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (client submits FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated (client submits FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/monthlyLedgers/{ledgerId.description: User-scoped collection of monthly rent and sub-meter ledger entries.

/users/{userId}/mainMeterLogs/{monthKey}.description: User-scoped collection of monthly government main meter logs.
